package coverage_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	svc "example.com/coverage/gen/coverage"
	value "example.com/coverage/gen/types/context"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type audit struct{}

func (audit) Audit(ctx context.Context, info *svc.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	p := info.Payload()
	p.SetValue(&value.Value{Text: p.Value().Text + ":audited"})
	return next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
}

func TestImportedAccessorTypes(t *testing.T) {
	client := svc.NewClient(nil, nil, func(_ context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
		return p.(*value.CInput).Value.Text, nil
	}, audit{})
	res, err := client.C(context.Background(), &value.CInput{Value: &value.Value{Text: "client"}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "client:audited", res)
	server := svc.WrapAEndpoint(func(_ context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
		return p.(*value.AInput).Value.Text, nil
	}, audit{})
	result, err := server(context.Background(), &value.AInput{Value: &value.Value{Text: "server"}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "server:audited", result)
}
